facts.text: I am looking for information on LGBTQ+ friendly gyms in my area.
I had a conversation with my friend Rachel about Rachel's experience of feeling marginalized in the LGBTQ+ community.
I realized how important it is to create safe spaces for everyone.
I want information on how to spot a gym that is not LGBTQ+ friendly.
I want to make sure I am not supporting a place that discriminates against people like Rachel.
I want examples of LGBTQ+-focused fitness classes or workshops that I could organize at my gym.
I want to know how to promote LGBTQ+-focused classes or workshops to the LGBTQ+ community.
I want guidance on creating a safe space for LGBTQ+ individuals at the gym in terms of language and communication.
I want to ensure my language is inclusive and respectful of all gender identities.
I want guidance on creating a safe space for LGBTQ+ individuals at the gym in terms of gender-neutral facilities and inclusive policies.
I want to learn how to make changes to ensure a welcoming environment for all members.

keyphrases: spot a gym not LGBTQ+ friendly
create safe spaces at the gym
